title: Take Escort Orders and Prep Each Visit
summary: Sort new escort orders, draft a visit prep note and write a short summary after each visit, with you checking every draft.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you take orders and visits yourself; the value is fewer lost orders and faster prep notes.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Orders are logged in one list, so fewer requests are lost.
Prep and summary drafts save time between visits.
